s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with chronic abdominal pain and vomiting, featuring a tender abdominal mass
salient_findings: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Diffuse lymphadenopathy and mesenteric mass on CT
key_facts: Normal passage of stool and flatus
Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Low bicarbonate, low PCO2, marginally acidotic pH on venous blood gas
No evidence of infection on urinalysis and blood cultures
CT Abdomen findings: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass
Mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus and mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain and mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Desmoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus and history of chronic abdominal pain

shortlist.label: Carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen and elevated lactate levels

shortlist.label: Metastatic cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Large mesenteric mass and diffuse lymphadenopathy on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus and elevated lactate levels

raw.rationale: The presence of diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen, along with the patient's symptoms of nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, are highly suggestive of lymphoma. The elevated lactate levels and acidotic pH also indicate a possible malignancy causing bowel obstruction or ischemia.

rejected.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
rejected.why: While it can cause abdominal pain and a mass, it typically does not cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or significantly elevated lactate levels.

rejected.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
rejected.why: It can cause abdominal pain and a mass, but it is less likely to cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: While it can cause a mass and abdominal pain, it is less likely to cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or the degree of systemic symptoms seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Desmoid tumor
rejected.why: It can cause a mass and abdominal pain, but it is less likely to cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Carcinoid tumor
rejected.why: While it can cause a mass and abdominal pain, it is less likely to cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient, and typically has other specific symptoms like flushing or diarrhea.

rejected.label: Metastatic cancer
rejected.why: While it can cause a mass and abdominal pain, the presence of diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass is more suggestive of a primary lymphoma rather than metastatic disease.

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: It can cause a mass and abdominal pain, but it is less likely to cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient.
